context: A retail manager and a cafe owner brainstorm a partnership
purpose: Teach: 小売/通販/入社/デバイス/インテリア/店内/応答/受け取っ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: うちの小売チェーンとカフェさんで、何か面白いコラボができないかと思って。
lines.en: I was wondering if our retail chain and your cafe could do an interesting collaboration.
lines.style: Polished business tone, warm but professional, slightly exploratory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 嬉しいご提案ですね。実は通販サイトを始めたばかりで、認知を広げたいんです。
lines.en: What a welcome proposal. Actually, we just launched an online store and want to grow awareness.
lines.style: Soft barista voice, friendly and pitching gently, hopeful undertone.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほど。私も入社してから新規事業の担当になって、ちょうど企画を探していて。
lines.en: I see. Since joining the company I've been on the new business team and was hunting for ideas.
lines.style: Open self-disclosure, professional yet personable, building rapport.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店内の雰囲気を活かして、お客様にタブレットなどのデバイスで注文体験をしてもらうのはどうでしょう。
lines.en: Using our in-store atmosphere, how about letting customers order via tablets or other devices?
lines.style: Creative pitch, calm and visual, inviting collaboration.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 面白いですね。うちのインテリアブランドの什器を置かせてもらえれば、両方の宣伝になります。
lines.en: Interesting. If we could place our interior brand's fixtures here, it would promote both sides.
lines.style: Quick business thinking, enthusiastic but measured, mutual-benefit framing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それは助かります。応答が早いお取引先だと、こちらも安心して進められます。
lines.en: That helps a lot. With a responsive partner, we can move forward with peace of mind.
lines.style: Grateful and slightly relieved, warm professional courtesy.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 先日サンプルを受け取った担当者からも、品質の評判はとても良かったですよ。
lines.en: The staff who received the samples the other day spoke very highly of your quality.
lines.style: Reassuring compliment, business-friendly, building trust through a small detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。では来週、企画書を持ってもう一度ご相談に伺いますね。
lines.en: Thank you. Then next week I'll bring a proposal and come consult with you again.
lines.style: Polite closing, eager forward momentum, classic Japanese business sign-off.
